// OPS-40 classifier: ทุกกรณีที่ PR แย่กว่า develop (PII หลุดเพิ่ม / id-amount-key หายเพิ่ม) → จำแนกว่าเข้าเงื่อนไข "develop ปิดค่า PII ผิดที่" หรือไม่
// usage: node cls-OPS40.mts A <seed0> <N> <keyset> <KM 0|1>   (generator ของ fuzz.mts/fz_nokm.mts)
//        node cls-OPS40.mts B <seed0> <seed1>                  (generator object ซ้อนของ builder ops40-fuzz4.ts, 500 object/seed)
//        node cls-OPS40.mts K <seed0> <N>                      (generator ของ keyq-OPS40.mts) — สำเนาของ builder: group ค่า 18 + หมวด EXEMPT4
import * as P from "./prx.ts"; import * as D from "./devx.ts"; import { inspect } from "node:util"; import { appendFileSync } from "node:fs";
const [gen, a1, a2, a3, a4] = process.argv.slice(2);
const prng = (seed: number) => () => { seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296 };
const RED = "[REDACTED]";
const PRV = new RegExp(P.KEY_VALUE.source, "gid"), PRO = new RegExp((P as any).PII_ONLY_X.source, "gid"), DV = new RegExp(D.KEY_VALUE.source, "gid");
type Sp = [number, number];
// ช่วงค่า (ไม่รวม prefix key) ที่ถูกแทนด้วย q[REDACTED]q — ตรงกับ replacer ของแต่ละฝั่ง
const piiSpans = (re: RegExp, s: string, off: number, out: Sp[]) => { re.lastIndex = 0; for (const m of s.matchAll(re)) { const st = m.index! + m[1].length; out.push([off + st, off + m.index! + m[0].length]) } };
const devSpans = (t: string) => { const o: Sp[] = []; piiSpans(DV, t, 0, o); return o };
const prSpans = (t: string) => { const o: Sp[] = []; for (const m of t.matchAll(PRV)) { const ix = (m as any).indices; if (m[11] === undefined) { o.push([m.index! + m[1].length, m.index! + m[0].length]) } else { piiSpans(PRO, m[11], ix[11][0], o); if (m[18] !== undefined) piiSpans(PRO, m[18], ix[18][0], o) } } return o };
const esc1 = (s: string) => JSON.stringify(s).slice(1, -1);
const mapUp = (t0: string, sp: Sp, lv: number): Sp => { let t = t0, [a, b] = sp; for (let i = 0; i < lv; i++) { a = 1 + esc1(t.slice(0, a)).length; b = 1 + esc1(t.slice(0, b)).length; t = JSON.stringify(t) } return [a, b] };
type Form = { name: string, f: (o: object) => string, iso: (k: string, v: unknown) => string, kp: (k: string) => string[] };
const isoInsp = (opts: object) => (k: string, v: unknown) => { const R = inspect({ [k]: v }, opts); for (const pre of [`{ ${k}: `, `{\n  ${k}: `]) if (R.startsWith(pre)) return R.slice(pre.length, R.length - (pre[1] === " " ? 2 : 2)); throw new Error("iso " + R) };
const FORMS_A: Form[] = [
  { name: "insp", f: o => inspect(o, { depth: 5 }), iso: isoInsp({ depth: 5 }), kp: k => [`${k}: `] },
  { name: "insp1", f: o => inspect(o, { depth: 5, breakLength: 1 }), iso: isoInsp({ depth: 5, breakLength: 1 }), kp: k => [`${k}: `] },
  { name: "inspInf", f: o => inspect(o, { depth: 5, breakLength: Infinity }), iso: isoInsp({ depth: 5, breakLength: Infinity }), kp: k => [`${k}: `] },
  { name: "json", f: o => JSON.stringify(o), iso: (k, v) => JSON.stringify(v), kp: k => [`"${k}":`] },
  { name: "jsonp", f: o => JSON.stringify(o, null, 2), iso: (k, v) => { const R = JSON.stringify({ [k]: v }, null, 2); return R.slice(`{\n  "${k}": `.length, -2) }, kp: k => [`"${k}": `] },
  { name: "invalid", f: o => "Invalid string: " + inspect(o, { depth: 5 }), iso: isoInsp({ depth: 5 }), kp: k => [`${k}: `] },
];
const FORMS_B: Form[] = [
  { name: "inspect", f: o => inspect(o, { depth: 6 }), iso: isoInsp({ depth: 6 }), kp: k => [`${k}: `] },
  { name: "inspect_bl1", f: o => inspect(o, { depth: 6, breakLength: 1 }), iso: isoInsp({ depth: 6, breakLength: 1 }), kp: k => [`${k}: `] },
  { name: "inspect_inf", f: o => inspect(o, { depth: 6, breakLength: Infinity }), iso: isoInsp({ depth: 6, breakLength: Infinity }), kp: k => [`${k}: `] },
  { name: "json", f: o => JSON.stringify(o), iso: (k, v) => JSON.stringify(v), kp: k => [`"${k}":`] },
  { name: "json2", f: o => JSON.stringify(o, null, 2), iso: (k, v) => { const R = JSON.stringify({ [k]: v }, null, 2); return R.slice(`{\n  "${k}": `.length, -2) }, kp: k => [`"${k}": `] },
];
// ตำแหน่งจริงของค่า PII ของ key k ในข้อความชั้น lv (null = หาไม่ได้แบบไม่กำกวม)
const trueSpan = (form: Form, obj: Record<string, unknown>, k: string, lv: number): Sp | null => {
  const T0 = form.f(obj); const E0 = form.iso(k, obj[k]); let hit = -1, n = 0;
  for (const kp of form.kp(k)) { let i = -1; while ((i = T0.indexOf(kp + E0, i + 1)) >= 0) { const pre = T0[i - 1]; if (i === 0 || /[\s{,"]/.test(pre)) { if (pre === '"' && !kp.startsWith('"')) continue; hit = i + kp.length; n++ } } }
  if (n !== 1) return null; return mapUp(T0, [hit, hit + E0.length], lv);
};

// ช่วงของ field ระดับบนสุด (key + ค่า) ในข้อความชั้น lv — render เดี่ยวแล้วหาในข้อความเต็ม (ค่าของ field ระดับบนสุดไม่ขึ้นกับ field ข้างเคียง)
const fieldSpan = (form: Form, obj: Record<string, unknown>, k: string, lv: number): Sp | null => {
  let E: string;
  if (form.name === "json") E = JSON.stringify({ [k]: obj[k] }).slice(1, -1);
  else if (form.name === "jsonp" || form.name === "json2") { const R = JSON.stringify({ [k]: obj[k] }, null, 2); E = R.slice(4, -2) }
  else { const R = form.f({ [k]: obj[k] }).replace(/^Invalid string: /, ""); E = R.startsWith("{ ") && R.endsWith(" }") ? R.slice(2, -2) : R.slice(4, -2) }
  if (!E) return null; const T0 = form.f(obj); let hit = -1, n = 0, i = -1;
  while ((i = T0.indexOf(E, i + 1)) >= 0) { const pre = T0[i - 1]; const post = T0[i + E.length]; if (/[\s{,]/.test(pre ?? " ") && /[\s,}]/.test(post ?? " ")) { hit = i; n++ } }
  if (n !== 1) return null; return mapUp(T0, [hit, hit + E.length], lv);
};
const outerSpans = (t: string): Sp[] => { const o: Sp[] = []; for (const m of t.matchAll(PRV)) o.push([m.index!, m.index! + m[0].length]); return o };
type Case = { obj: Record<string, unknown>, piiFields: { k: string, mark: string }[], kept: { item: string, key: string }[] };
const ren = (form: Form, o: object, lv: number) => { let t = form.f(o); for (let i = 0; i < lv; i++) t = JSON.stringify(t); return t };
const covered = (sp: Sp[], pos: number, len: number) => sp.some(([a, b]) => a <= pos && pos + len <= b);
const markPos = (t: string, fieldSp: Sp | null, mark: string) => { if (fieldSp) { const i = t.indexOf(mark, fieldSp[0]); if (i >= 0 && i < fieldSp[1]) return i } return t.indexOf(mark) };
// ผลต่อ field: หลุดไหม (ตามตำแหน่ง marker ในช่วงค่าของ field นั้น)
const analyse = (form: Form, c: Case, lv: number) => {
  const t = ren(form, c.obj, lv), p = P.redactPii(t), d = D.redactPii(t);
  const ps = prSpans(t), ds = devSpans(t);
  const fields = c.piiFields.map(({ k, mark }) => { const sp = trueSpan(form, c.obj, k, lv); const pos = markPos(t, sp, mark); return { k, mark, sp, pos, leakP: pos >= 0 && !covered(ps, pos, mark.length), leakD: pos >= 0 && !covered(ds, pos, mark.length) } });
  const lost = c.kept.filter(x => t.includes(x.item) && !p.includes(x.item) && d.includes(x.item));
  return { t, p, d, ps, ds, fields, lost };
};
// การปิดค่าของ field G ของฝั่งหนึ่ง: exact = มีช่วง redact เท่ากับค่าจริงพอดี
const closeKind = (spans: Sp[], sp: Sp | null) => {
  if (!sp) return "nospan";
  const [s, e] = sp; const inter = spans.filter(([a, b]) => a < e && b > s);
  if (inter.length === 1 && inter[0][0] === s && inter[0][1] === e) return "exact";
  if (!inter.length) return "none";
  const st = inter.find(([a]) => a === s);
  if (st) return st[1] < e ? "early" : "late"; // เริ่มถูกที่ ปิดก่อน/หลังจุดจบจริง
  return inter.some(([a, b]) => a < s && b > s) ? "swallowed-from-before" : "partial-inside";
};
const neutral = (v: unknown, mark: string): unknown => typeof v === "string" ? v.split(mark).map(x => x.replace(/./gsu, "a")).join(mark) : Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(x => neutral(x, mark)) : v;
const stats: Record<string, number> = {}; const inc = (k: string) => stats[k] = (stats[k] ?? 0) + 1;
const OUT = process.env.OUT ?? `cls5_${gen}_${a1}_${a3 ?? ""}_${a4 ?? ""}.jsonl`;
function classify(form: Form, c: Case, lv: number, genuineFilter: (m: string, k: string) => boolean) {
  const A = analyse(form, c, lv);
  // กรณีที่ PR แย่กว่า: field หลุดใน PR ไม่หลุดใน develop (+ ตัวกรอง genuine ของ fuzz เดิม), และของที่ PR ทำหายแต่ develop ไม่หาย
  const bads: { kind: "leak" | "lost", what: string, pos: number }[] = [];
  for (const f of A.fields) if (f.leakP && !f.leakD && genuineFilter(f.mark, f.k)) bads.push({ kind: "leak", what: f.mark, pos: f.pos });
  for (const x of A.lost) { const kp = A.t.indexOf(x.key); bads.push({ kind: "lost", what: x.item, pos: kp }) }
  // ตรวจความสอดคล้องกับการตรวจแบบ includes
  if (new Set(c.piiFields.map(x => x.mark)).size === c.piiFields.length) for (const f of A.fields) { if (!f.sp) inc("note_nospan"); const ip = A.t.includes(f.mark) && A.p.includes(f.mark), id = A.t.includes(f.mark) && A.d.includes(f.mark); if (ip !== f.leakP) inc("WARN_leak_mismatch_pr"); if (id !== f.leakD) inc("WARN_leak_mismatch_dev") }
  if (!bads.length) return;
  for (const b of bads) {
    inc(`bad_${b.kind}`);
    // เงื่อนไข: field PII G (อยู่ก่อนจุดที่เสียหาย) ที่ develop ปิดค่าผิดที่ "จากเนื้อหาของค่าเอง" — render {G: v, id} เดี่ยว (serializer/ชั้นเดียวกัน)
    // แล้วช่วงที่ develop redact ไม่ตรงช่วงค่าจริง (จบก่อน/หลัง/เหลือชิ้นส่วน) — ไม่ขึ้นกับ key/ค่าอื่นในบรรทัด
    const intrinsic = (k: string) => { const o1 = { [k]: c.obj[k], id: "c" }; const t1 = ren(form, o1, lv); const sp1 = trueSpan(form, o1, k, lv); return { dk: closeKind(devSpans(t1), sp1), pk: closeKind(prSpans(t1), sp1) } };
    const misDev = A.fields.filter(g => g.sp && g.sp[0] < b.pos).map(g => ({ g, ...intrinsic(g.k), ctx: closeKind(A.ds, g.sp) })).filter(x => x.dk === "early" || x.dk === "late" || x.dk === "partial-inside");
    const looseD1 = A.fields.some(g => g.sp && g.sp[0] < b.pos && !["exact","early","late","partial-inside"].includes(intrinsic(g.k).dk)); if (looseD1) inc("info_dev_iso_none_or_nospan");
    const ctxOnly = A.fields.filter(g => g.sp && g.sp[0] < b.pos && closeKind(A.ds, g.sp) !== "exact" && !misDev.some(x => x.g.k === g.k)); if (ctxOnly.length) inc("info_dev_ctx_misclose_not_intrinsic");
    let cls: string;
    if (A.fields.some(g => !g.sp && g.pos < b.pos)) inc("note_unlocated_field");
    if (!misDev.length) cls = "NOT_EXEMPT_no_dev_misclose";
    else {
      // counterfactual: ทำค่าของ G ทุกตัวที่ develop ปิดผิดที่ให้เป็นตัวอักษรธรรมดา (คง marker/ความยาว) แล้วดูว่า PR ยังแย่กว่าหรือไม่
      const still = (gs: string[]) => { const o2: Record<string, unknown> = { ...c.obj }; for (const k of gs) { const m = c.piiFields.find(x => x.k === k)!.mark; o2[k] = neutral(o2[k], m) } const B = analyse(form, { ...c, obj: o2 }, lv); return b.kind === "leak" ? B.fields.some(f => f.mark === b.what && f.leakP && !f.leakD) : B.lost.some(x => x.item === b.what) };
      const allK = misDev.map(x => x.g.k);
      const fK = b.kind === "leak" ? c.piiFields.find(x => x.mark === b.what)!.k : null;
      const others = allK.filter(k => k !== fK);
      if (still(allK)) cls = "NOT_EXEMPT_cf_persists";
      else if (others.length && !still(others)) cls = "EXEMPT_other_field";
      else cls = "EXEMPT_self_or_combo";
      inc(`dk_${misDev.map(x => x.dk).join("+")}`); inc(`pk_${misDev.map(x => x.pk).join("+")}`);
    }
    // ข้อยกเว้นข้อ 4 (owner 2026-11-25 ครั้งที่ 2): ชื่อ key ใน ' บนบรรทัดเดียวกับสมาชิกก่อนหน้า (หลัง `{ `/`, `) ที่มี backslash หน้า quote ในชื่อ key
    // counterfactual: แทน \ ' " ` ในชื่อ key เหล่านั้น (ทุกระดับของ object/Map) ด้วย a คงความยาว แล้ว PR ต้องไม่แย่กว่า develop ที่ X อีก — หมวดแยก
    // (d2) แบบเข้มของ reviewer: key ใน ' ที่อยู่ inline (หลัง `{ ` / `, ` ไม่มี newline นำ) ใน render ชั้น 0, ชื่อ key ที่ render แล้วมี backslash
    // ติดหน้า quote (รวม quote ปิด), อยู่ก่อน X และ counterfactual แทน \ ' " ` เฉพาะใน key เหล่านั้นด้วย a แล้ว PR ไม่แย่กว่า develop ที่ X อีก
    const builderD2 = (() => { if (!cls.startsWith("NOT")) return null;
      const t0 = form.f(c.obj);
      const inlineBsKey = (k: string) => { if (!/\\/.test(k) && !(/'/.test(k) && /"/.test(k) && /`/.test(k))) return false; const R = inspect({ [k]: 1 }); if (!R.startsWith("{ '")) return false; const repr = R.slice(2, R.lastIndexOf(": 1 }")); return t0.includes("{ " + repr + ":") || t0.includes(", " + repr + ":") || t0.includes("{ " + repr + " =>") || t0.includes(", " + repr + " =>") };
      let changed = 0;
      const ren2 = (v: unknown): unknown => {
        const nk = (k: string) => { if (inlineBsKey(k)) { changed++; return k.replace(/[\\'"`]/g, "a") } return k };
        if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(ren2);
        if (v instanceof Map) return new Map([...v].map(([k, x]) => [typeof k === "string" ? nk(k) : k, ren2(x)]));
        if (v && typeof v === "object" && (Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === Object.prototype || Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === null)) { const o = Object.create(Object.getPrototypeOf(v)); for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(v)) o[nk(k)] = ren2(x); return o }
        return v;
      };
      const o3 = ren2(c.obj) as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (!changed) return false; const B = analyse(form, { ...c, obj: o3 }, lv); const st = b.kind === "leak" ? B.fields.some(f => f.mark === b.what && f.leakP && !f.leakD) : B.lost.some(x => x.item === b.what); return !st })();
    if (cls.startsWith("NOT")) {
      const t0 = form.f(c.obj);
      let xPos0: number;
      if (b.kind === "leak") { const fk = A.fields.find(f => f.mark === b.what && f.pos === b.pos) ?? A.fields.find(f => f.mark === b.what)!; const sp0 = trueSpan(form, c.obj, fk.k, 0); xPos0 = sp0 ? sp0[0] : t0.length } else xPos0 = t0.indexOf(c.kept.find(x => x.item === b.what)!.key);
      const isD2Key = (k: string) => { const R = inspect({ [k]: 1 }); if (!R.startsWith("{ '") && !R.startsWith("{ `")) return false; const repr = R.slice(2, R.lastIndexOf(": 1 }")); if (!/\\['"`]/.test(repr.slice(1))) return false;
        for (const pre of ["{ ", ", "]) for (const post of [":", " =>"]) { let i = -1; while ((i = t0.indexOf(pre + repr + post, i + 1)) >= 0) if (i < xPos0) return true } return false };
      let changed = 0;
      const ren3 = (v: unknown): unknown => {
        const nk = (k: string) => { if (isD2Key(k)) { changed++; return k.replace(/[\\'"`]/g, "a") } return k };
        if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(ren3);
        if (v instanceof Map) return new Map([...v].map(([k, x]) => [typeof k === "string" ? nk(k) : k, ren3(x)]));
        if (v && typeof v === "object" && (Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === Object.prototype || Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === null)) { const o = Object.create(Object.getPrototypeOf(v)); for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(v)) o[nk(k)] = ren3(x); return o }
        return v;
      };
      const o3 = ren3(c.obj) as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (changed) { const B = analyse(form, { ...c, obj: o3 }, lv); const st = b.kind === "leak" ? B.fields.some(f => f.mark === b.what && f.leakP && !f.leakD) : B.lost.some(x => x.item === b.what); if (!st) cls = "EXEMPT_d2_strict" }
    }
    // (d3) การสแกนเลื่อนเพราะ key/สตริงของ field ที่ไม่ใช่ PII ที่ regex อ่านโครงสร้างไม่ได้ — ต้องเป็น field เดียว F (ระดับบนสุด, ไม่ใช่ key PII, อยู่ก่อน field ของ X):
    //  ① key หรือสตริงใดใน F (รวม key/ค่าซ้อน, Map key, สมาชิก array) มีอักขระโครงสร้าง  \n \r { } [ ] : , ' " ` \ +
    //  ② ต้นเหตุอยู่ใน F: ไม่มี match ของ PR คร่อมจุดเริ่มของ F และมี match ที่เริ่มใน F แล้วจบเลยจุดจบของ F
    //  ③ แทนอักขระโครงสร้างในข้อความของ F ด้วย a (คงความยาว ไม่แตะ field PII/marker) ใน object เต็ม แล้ว PR ไม่แย่กว่า develop ที่ X
    if (cls.startsWith("NOT")) {
      const STRUCT = /[\n\r{}\[\]:,'"`\\+]/g; const hasS = (x: string) => /[\n\r{}\[\]:,'"`\\+]/.test(x);
      const PIIK = new Set(["email","phone","name","first_name","last_name","company","address_1","address_2","line1","line2","city","province","state","postal_code"]);
      const anyS = (v: unknown, depth = 0): boolean => typeof v === "string" ? hasS(v) : depth > 8 || v === null || typeof v !== "object" ? false : Array.isArray(v) ? v.some(x => anyS(x, depth + 1)) : v instanceof Map ? [...v].some(([k, x]) => (typeof k === "string" && hasS(k)) || anyS(x, depth + 1)) : (Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === Object.prototype || Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === null) ? Object.entries(v).some(([k, x]) => hasS(k) || anyS(x, depth + 1)) : false;
      const neu = (v: unknown, depth = 0): unknown => typeof v === "string" ? v.replace(STRUCT, "a") : depth > 8 || v === null || typeof v !== "object" ? v : Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(x => neu(x, depth + 1)) : v instanceof Map ? new Map([...v].map(([k, x]) => [typeof k === "string" ? k.replace(STRUCT, "a") : k, neu(x, depth + 1)])) : (Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === Object.prototype || Object.getPrototypeOf(v) === null) ? (() => { const o = Object.create(Object.getPrototypeOf(v)); for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(v)) o[k.replace(STRUCT, "a")] = neu(x, depth + 1); return o })() : v;
      const keys = Object.keys(c.obj);
      const xKey = b.kind === "leak" ? (A.fields.find(f => f.mark === b.what && f.pos === b.pos) ?? A.fields.find(f => f.mark === b.what)!).k : c.kept.find(x => x.item === b.what)!.key;
      const xi = keys.indexOf(xKey);
      const worseAt = (o: Record<string, unknown>, pf: typeof c.piiFields, kept: typeof c.kept) => { const B = analyse(form, { obj: o, piiFields: pf, kept }, lv); return b.kind === "leak" ? B.fields.some(f => f.mark === b.what && f.leakP && !f.leakD) : B.lost.some(x => x.item === b.what) };
      let d3 = false, d3full = 0, d3iso = 0;
      if (xi > 0) for (const fk of keys.slice(0, xi)) {
        if (PIIK.has(fk.toLowerCase()) || !(hasS(fk) || anyS(c.obj[fk]))) continue;
        const nk = fk.replace(STRUCT, "a"), nv = neu(c.obj[fk]);
        // ③ object เต็ม

        o[pick(PII_KEYS)] = piiValue();
        for (const [k, val] of KNOWN) if (r() < 0.5) { o[k + (n || "")] = val; keptK.push({ item: k + (n || ""), key: k + (n || "") }, { item: String(val), key: k + (n || "") }) }
        if (r() < 0.3) o[pick(PII_KEYS)] = piiValue();
      }
      const id = `cart_${seed}x${i}`; o.id = id; keptK.push({ item: id, key: id });
      const piiFields = Object.keys(o).filter(k => typeof o[k] === "string" && (o[k] as string).includes(MARK)).map(k => ({ k, mark: MARK }));
      for (const form of FF) for (let k = 0; k <= 3; k++) { inc("total"); classify(form, { obj: o, piiFields, kept: keptK }, k, () => true) }
    }
  }
} else {
  const s0 = +a1, s1 = +a2; const MARK = "PIIMARK";
  const OPEN = ["a, b:", ", ", "name: '", 'name: "', "phone: ", '"name":"', "\n  t:", "x: [", "{ a: '", "k: ", ", rv: ", "]", "[", "'", '"', "`", "\\", "+"];
  const KEYS = ["", "note", "x-a", "it's", 'say "hi"', "a\\b", "a\nb", "ชื่อ", "0", "items", "k".repeat(140)];
  const PII_KEYS = ["name", "first_name", "address_1", "city", "email", "postal_code", "phone"];
  const CH = ["'", '"', "`", "\\", "\n", "[", "]", ",", ":", " ", "a", "{", "}", "+", "ส", "-", "\t"];
  const START = ["+66 ", ",", "]", "}", "\n", "สม", " ", ":\t", "(", ""];
  const KNOWN: [string, unknown][] = [["total", "1999.50"], ["amount", 250], ["display_id", 1042], ["request_id", "req_01ABC"], ["currency_code", "thb"]];
  for (let seed = s0; seed <= s1; seed++) {
    const r = prng(seed); const int = (n: number) => Math.floor(r() * n); const pick = <T,>(a: T[]) => a[int(a.length)];
    const rs = (n: number) => { let t = ""; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) t += pick(CH); return t };
    const leaf = () => rs(int(3)) + pick(OPEN);
    const nested = (d: number): unknown => {
      if (d === 0 || r() < 0.25) return leaf();
      const x = int(5);
      if (x === 0) return Array.from({ length: 1 + int(3) }, () => nested(d - 1));
      if (x === 1) return [Object.fromEntries([[pick(KEYS), nested(d - 1)]])];
      if (x === 2) return new Map([[pick(KEYS), nested(d - 1)]]);
      if (x === 3) { const o = Object.create(null); o[pick(KEYS)] = nested(d - 1); return o }
      return Object.fromEntries(Array.from({ length: 1 + int(2) }, () => [pick(KEYS), nested(d - 1)]));
    };
    for (let i = 0; i < 500; i++) {
      const o: Record<string, unknown> = {}; const keptK: { item: string, key: string }[] = [];
      for (let n = 0; n < 1 + int(2); n++) {
        o[pick(["note", "d", "m", "x-a", "items"]) + n] = nested(1 + int(3));
        o[pick(PII_KEYS)] = pick(START) + rs(int(4)) + MARK + rs(int(4));
        for (const [k, v] of KNOWN) if (r() < 0.5) { o[k + n] = v; keptK.push({ item: k + n, key: k + n }, { item: String(v), key: k + n }) }
      }
      const id = `cart_${seed}x${i}`; o.id = id; keptK.push({ item: id, key: id });
      const piiFields = PII_KEYS.filter(k => k in o).map(k => ({ k, mark: MARK }));
      for (const form of FORMS_B) for (let k = 0; k <= 3; k++) { inc("total"); classify(form, { obj: o, piiFields, kept: keptK }, k, () => true) }
    }
  }
}
console.log(JSON.stringify({ gen, a1, a2, a3, a4, ...stats }));
